production.direction_en: Odelia warns the party about mines. A bell pulse crosses the bridge; one lock of Fadyme’s ash-pale hair turns stark white, whiter than bone.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch5_bridge | the bell pulse: sting_bell_toll, then silence while the lock turns white; bgm_fadyme_theme returns only on 'Only tired.' | post: bgm_quiet_sorrow

commands.speaker: odelia_pike
commands.text: The stones are hollow under the third span. Do not run when the bell rings.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I was not going to run.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Your voice changed. Are you hurt?
